context.temperature_source: Berkeley Earth (daily mean of Tmax and Tmin)
context.method: Crop-weighted complete growing seasons; a separate linear time trend is removed from each metric. At least 90% spatial crop coverage and every day of the season are required. At least 10 complete seasons are required for a trend. Historical context only; no additional response fit or current-season forecast.
